parsed.post: New best! Increased DEPTH to 6 and reduced TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. Reducing batch size to gain more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget seems to be paying off. Next, I'll try adding a LR warmup and increasing weight decay to further stabilize this deeper, higher-step training regime.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 for more steps, and adding LR warmup (0.05) and higher weight decay (0.1) for stability.
